_comment: THIS FILE IS THE STARTING CHECKLIST. Edit it on GitHub and commit - the site redeploys and picks up the changes by itself, until the first edit is made inside the app (Checklists screen), after which the app owns them and this file stops being applied. "Restore from the checklist file" on that screen hands control back and rewrites everything from here. Each building has a flat list of things to tick off - broad areas, not individual jobs. An entry is ["Name"], or ["Name", "Optional note"], and can take a third value: "photo" to allow a photo against it, or "photo required" to insist on one.
_everyVisit_note: Added to the bottom of EVERY building's checklist, on both a Full Clean and a Check. Empty on purpose - the buildings are being built in the app instead.
_cleaningTypes_note: Every building has two checklists: "full" is the Full Clean, "check" is the quicker Check. An entry named on both lists is stored once and counts either way.
_buildings_note: Deliberately down to one building with one item. The real buildings and checklists are being built on the Checklists screen in the app, which takes ownership the moment the first edit is made there. This entry stays as a working example of the shape, and as something to check the file still reaches the app at all.
